info.title: ParkPath API
info.description: Backend for the ParkPath capstone project.

get.description: Liveness check — does the process respond at all. No DB dependency.

Readiness check — can we actually reach Postgres. Deploy platforms
(Render/Railway) and future CI smoke tests should hit this, not just /health.

post.description:
Sign in with Google. The same Google account always reaches the same
ParkPath account; a Google account whose (verified) email already has
a ParkPath account is linked to it; otherwise a new account is made
from the Google profile, with a username from the email that the app
then offers to change.

get.description:
Example of a protected route. Halie/Dylan: this is the pattern to
copy for any route that needs to know who's logged in — add
`current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)` as a parameter.

delete.description:
Deletes the account for good: its trips (and their photos), comments,
friendships, wishlist and profile picture all go with it (the database
removes everything that belongs to a user along with them).

get.description:
Public, so the sign-up form can check as you type. Says only whether a
name is free, never whose it is.

get.description:
Every national park's outline, coarsened to ~100 m (3 decimal places),
for the app to tell on the device whether you're inside one: it never
sends its location here. Declared before /{park_code} so "boundaries"
isn't read as a park code.

A national park's boundary, roads and trails, for drawing its own map.

One of the park's official brochure maps, as a JPEG (see app/brochure_maps.py).

BrochureMapOut.title: BrochureMapOut

FriendOut.title: FriendOut
FriendOut.description: One entry in the signed-in user's friends list: the *other* person.

FriendRequestCreate.title: FriendRequestCreate
FriendRequestCreate.description: Who to ask: by email, or by username (typed, or from their QR code).

FriendshipOut.title: FriendshipOut
FriendshipOut.description: A friend request, pending or accepted, with both people named.

GoogleSignIn.title: GoogleSignIn
GoogleSignIn.description: POST /auth/google: the ID token the phone got from Google.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Where the person starts, already converted from their zip code by the app.

MapLabelOut.title: MapLabelOut
MapLabelOut.description: Where a label is printed on a brochure map, in the image's pixels.

ParkBoundaryOut.title: ParkBoundaryOut
ParkBoundaryOut.description: A park's outline, for working out on the device whether you're in it.

PassportStampOut.title: PassportStampOut
PassportStampOut.description: One national park's stamp: earned by logging a visit.

PhotoUploadOut.title: PhotoUploadOut
PhotoUploadOut.description:
A signed form for one photo or video upload. The app sends a multipart
POST to `upload_url`: every entry of `fields` first, in order, then the
file as the last part named `file`. Then it passes `key` in `photos`
when it saves the trip. The form stops working after `expires_in`
seconds.

PhotoUploadRequest.title: PhotoUploadRequest
PhotoUploadRequest.description: Ask for permission to upload one photo or video.

QuizAnswers.title: QuizAnswers
QuizAnswers.description: The onboarding quiz, as the app sends it. Every question is required.

SavedQuiz.title: SavedQuiz
SavedQuiz.description: The quiz as GET/PUT /quiz keep it: the answers plus the zip code they gave.

SignalScores.title: SignalScores
SignalScores.description: Each signal's match from 0 to 1, or null when it isn't in use.

SiteOut.title: SiteOut
SiteOut.description:
One NPS site. Curated fields are null for sites nobody has filled in
yet (most of the non-park units), so clients must handle missing values.

SnoozeIn.title: SnoozeIn
SnoozeIn.description:
Optional body for PUT /snoozes/{park_code}. Without `until` the park is
set aside for the usual 30 days; with it (a snooze carried over from
the phone), until then, but never more than 30 days out.

StampPhotoOut.title: StampPhotoOut
StampPhotoOut.description: The photo of the park's passport stamp on a trip.

TripPhotoIn.title: TripPhotoIn
TripPhotoIn.description: A photo or video on a trip: its key from the upload, and its caption.

TripUpdate.title: TripUpdate
TripUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent change. `rating` can be set to null to clear it.

`trails` replaces the list. `stamp`, the older one-trail form, sets the
first trail (keeping the rest), or removes it when null; it's ignored
when `trails` is sent. Likewise `photos` replaces the photos and their
captions, and `photo_keys` (keys only) is ignored when it's sent.
`stamp_photo_key` replaces the passport-stamp photo, or removes it when
null. `feedback` replaces the feedback tags (send [] to clear them).

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
PATCH /auth/me: any of these; the rest are left as they are. Changing
the email also needs the current password.

UsernameCheck.title: UsernameCheck
UsernameCheck.description: GET /auth/username-available: whether it's free, and if not, why.

WishlistItemOut.title: WishlistItemOut
WishlistItemOut.description: One saved site. The app already has the site details from GET /sites.
